svg.aria-label: Other completion approvals with perforation flags
svg.title: Other completion approvals with perforation flags
svg.text: Other completion approvals with perforation flags
Flags are counted on permits for other completion work without a change of zone. A permit may carry
both flags. Hollow markers show partial 2026 through 23 November 2026. Means end in 2025. Y maximum 80,
against 800 in Figure 1A, 800 in Figure 1B, 150 in Figure 1C, 800 in Figure 2A, 800 in Figure 2B.
